## Orientation

Code in `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/deep-links`. Store writes only from primary checkout — do not edit `.artifacts`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R4: A record id shaped like `rec-…` opens the record overlay.
R7: Where a title is known from the snapshot or detail payload, the visible link label prefers title (and type when helpful) over the raw id.
R8: Unresolved references remain plain text (no broken navigation).

Unit coverage also includes token detection and href builders for task, phase, requirement, and milestone shapes used by later wiring.

## Approach

Add `dashboard/web/ui/src/links.ts` with `resolveRef(token, ctx) -> { href, label } | null` (and any small helpers needed). Resolve against the current snapshot and optional detail payload. Prefer title/type labels when known; return null for unresolved tokens. Unit-test in `links.test.ts` with R4/R7/R8 cases plus builders for the other shapes.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R4: A record id shaped like `rec-…` opens the record overlay.
R7: Where a title is known from the snapshot or detail payload, the visible link label prefers title (and type when helpful) over the raw id.
R8: Unresolved references remain plain text (no broken navigation).

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

- Unresolved tokens unchanged.
- Overlay close/back behavior unchanged.

## Assumptions

- Requirement links need effort+phase context; without it they stay plain text (R8).

deep-links-surfaces: Linkify known reference shapes in list meta and in rendered markdown bodies
deep-links-labels: Prefer human title and type as the visible label; show id as secondary or title attribute
